images.prompt:
Original adult Christmas colouring-book art in expressive black fineliner on clean white paper: confident variable-weight contours, crisp hand-inked architectural detail, gentle organic curves, high but colourable patterned detail, spacious enclosed shapes, sparse contour hatching and stippling, selective black accents, deep layered storytelling, magical intimate winter-night mood, monochrome only, home-print-friendly.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Original festive adult colouring-book illustration in expressive black fineliner, combining cosy architectural storytelling with decorative seasonal pattern work.; line weight: Fine-to-medium variable black outlines, with slightly heavier outer contours and foreground framing elements.; line quality: Clean, confident hand-inked contours; gently imperfect organic curves; precise architectural marks; controlled short hatching.; detail level: High but colourable detail: layered environmental motifs, architectural trims and small festive accents balanced with generous enclosed areas for pencils and pens.; character language: Stylised storybook figures, if included, with simple readable silhouettes, warm restrained expressions and uncluttered facial features.; background density: Richly detailed, deep-view backgrounds built in receding layers; distant elements simplify to preserve clear focal areas.; composition: Framed-viewpoint compositions with a strong visual threshold, clear focal hierarchy, layered depth and deliberate breathing room within major colourable shapes.; palette: Monochrome artwork only; line design should support a colourist’s own winter-night palette of deep blue, evergreen, berry red, warm gold and soft ivory.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: Minimal contour-following hatching, sparse stippling and selective black fills to imply night-time contrast without pre-colouring or muddying the page.; texture: Crisp uncoated-paper ink feel, with patterned surface details expressed through simple repeatable marks rather than grey tonal rendering.; mood: Magical, intimate, nostalgic and quietly festive..

PAGE 2 of "Christmas Night Windows Colouring Book" (colouring): Exact small title text “The Wreath Window”; inside-cottage viewpoint through a mullioned window, a large evergreen wreath with bow, orange slices and star ornaments centred on the glass; candle, teacup and knitted mittens on the sill; snowy stone wall and bare winter branches outside.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Each single-sided page uses a substantial illustrated window, doorway or shopfront frame inset safely from the edges, with open enclosed areas for relaxed colouring. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copyrighted characters, logos, brand imagery or recognisable existing colouring-book compositions; Photorealism, painterly greyscale rendering, colour fills or watercolour effects; Overcrowded micro-detail, muddy tonal shading or large solid-black ink areas; Thin broken outlines, inconsistent perspective or illegible architectural forms; Misspelled text, decorative pseudo-text or unreliable generated lettering; Childish cartoon styling, exaggerated kawaii features or overly cutesy expressions.
